subject: Enablement facilitator cadence + walkthrough deliverables for Lumen Apps
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@lumenapps.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@lumenapps.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Enablement — facilitator cadence & recorded walkthroughs request

Hi Mina + Marissa,

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday — our product and ops teams are excited to get hands-on. To make the internal rollouts smooth, can you share a proposed facilitator cadence (live sessions + office hours equivalents) and a plan for the recorded walkthroughs we can reference for async teams?

High-level asks from our side:
- Four live facilitator sessions (2x 90m technical, 2x 60m product/business) across two weeks for engineers + PMs
- Weekly drop-in hours for 6 weeks (we have engineers distributed across PST/CEST)
- Short recorded walkthroughs (10–20m) covering: deployment basics, routing policies, observability dashboard tour, and common troubleshooting steps
- One-pager exec summary (for procurement + platform leads) that outlines outcomes and required seats/licenses

Target start: week of Sep 6. Can you confirm availability and share the materials/recording plan so I can block time and loop in our Platform lead?

Attachments: Lumen-implementation-requirements.docx (they sent an internal requirements doc)

Best,
Sophie Turner
Customer Success Manager
Lumen Apps
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@lumenapps.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Enablement — facilitator cadence & recorded walkthroughs request

Hi Sophie — appreciate the clear asks and the requirements doc. Draft plan attached.

Summary of proposed facilitator cadence (attached: enablement-facilitator-cadence-v1.pdf):
- Week 1: Tech deep-dive (90m) + Product enablement (60m) — recorded
- Week 2: Advanced ops & KV cache/batching lab (90m) + Stakeholder Q&A (60m) — recorded
- Drop-in hours: Tue/Thu 10–11am PST for first 3 weeks, then Tue 10–11am PST for remaining 3 weeks (we'll rotate a second slot to 3–4pm CEST on alternate weeks)

Recorded walkthroughs (index attached: walkthroughs-index.csv) will be delivered as:
- Deployment checklist + VPC setup (12m)
- Routing & model variant fallbacks (15m)
- Console walkthrough: dashboards, trace links, cost breakdowns (14m)
- Troubleshooting common latency/cold-start scenarios (10m)

Next steps / asks:
1) Sophie: Confirm the two preferred weeks for live sessions (we tentatively penciled Sep 6 and Sep 13).
2) Marissa: Can you own facilitator assignments and the 1-pager exec summary? I'll prep the session slides and lab resources.
3) Sophie: Any constraints on recording access (e.g., internal-only links or shared with contractor trainers)?

[attachment: enablement-facilitator-cadence-v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
[attachment: walkthroughs-index.csv (text/csv)]

Thanks — I can host the first two facilitator sessions.

— Mina Haddad
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>; Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@lumenapps.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 13:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Enablement — facilitator cadence & recorded walkthroughs request

Thanks Mina + Sophie — happy to take the exec one-pager and assign facilitators. Quick notes from an enablement ops perspective:

Facilitator assignments (proposed):
- Technical deep-dive (session 1): Connor O'Brien (SE) + Mina (CSM)
- Product enablement (session 2): Marissa Cole (PM enablement)
- Advanced ops lab (session 3): Connor (lead lab facilitation)
- Stakeholder Q&A (session 4): Mina + Marissa

Session scripts: I'll prepare 4 slide decks with synchronized demo scripts so recordings are modular (we won't need full re-records for minor updates).

Logistics:
- Zoom meetings will be created as recurring links; recordings will be uploaded to the Drive folder provided in the related links.
- Titles for recordings will match the index CSV to simplify search and embedding in your LMS.
- For timezone coverage: We'll label each drop-in as PST-first or CEST-first and rotate the second slot as Mina suggested.

Connor, can you confirm lab access method (ephemeral API keys or temporary sandbox accounts) and a short README for attendees? Put the README in the shared drive and cc the Lumen PMs.

— Marissa Cole
Customer Enablement Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@lumenapps.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>; Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@lumenapps.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Enablement — facilitator cadence & recorded walkthroughs request

This looks great — confirmed Sep 6 and Sep 13 for the live weeks. A couple of asks from procurement and platform leads:
- Procurement: please include a concise line in the exec one-pager about license seats and expected token consumption for peak training windows (procurement@lumenapps.com)
- Platform lead: prefer recordings to be internal-only links (we'll share with contractors case-by-case)

Also can we get a 1-page exec summary by Fri Aug 28 so I can circulate before our steering meeting on Sep 1?

Thanks — Sophie
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@lumenapps.com>; Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Enablement — facilitator cadence & recorded walkthroughs request

Hi Sophie / team — lab access details below and I've dropped the README in the shared Drive.

Lab access plan:
- Sandbox org created for Lumen Apps (credentials: ephemeral API keys generated per attendee)
- Access expires 30 days after the final live session; extended access available on request
- Rate limits set to mimic your expected production throughput for training scenarios (details in README)

I uploaded: lab-access-instructions.txt and a sample script for the KV cache lab to the Drive folder. Zoom recurring links will be created by Marissa tomorrow; recordings will be internal-only by default.

If you'd like, I can draft the short cost estimate line for the exec one-pager and send it to Marissa to fold in — it'll be a peak-cost delta estimate based on the training sessions + recorded playback views.

[attachment: lab-access-instructions.txt (text/plain)]

— Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
